verdict.rationale: Unit's docs confirm deposit/wallet accounts are held in FBO structures and dashboard/API access exposes account and compliance data, but there is no explicit documentation of how FDIC insurance attaches (pass-through vs pooled) or granular ledger-visibility/permissions for finance stakeholders. Missing for 10: explicit FDIC insurance attachment details, ledger access-control/permission documentation, and independent confirmation of account-structure transparency.
